Hands Down - The Best Burger Joint in Da Nang!
Feb 2026 • Solo
I have a confession: when I land in Da Nang, I just put Chops into Grab because I already know that’s where my mouth wants to be.

I haven’t tried everything on the menu, but everything I have tried has been excellent. The ingredients taste fresh and high quality, the food is consistently well prepared, and the portions and pricing make it an especially good value for the quality you’re getting.

The staff are always professional, friendly, and accommodating, and the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming without feeling generic or touristy. The location is hard to beat too—just a block from the beach.

On one trip, I went there every single day, sometimes twice in the same day. That probably says more than any five-star review could.
